name: Terasaki Ria
source:
She used to have a bit of a "gyaru" style and was in the same class and club as Yuuto and the others.

She was popular among the boys, partially due to the contrast between her looks and her serious, dedicated attitude as the ace of her school club.

On the other hand, she struggled with academics and admired Yuuto for his ability to handle everything with ease.

[Translated from [url=https://www.hs-crowd.co.jp/anim/product/pro_pc/pc094/index.html]official website[/url]]
